title: Crash clicking documentation links in EditorSettings tooltips from the Project Manager
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: v4.6.dev.custom_build [3edd256a6], v4.6.dev5.official [f5918a9d3]
- Not reproducible in: 4.5.1.stable, v4.6.dev2.official [7864ac801], v4.6.dev3.official [9d84f3d13]

### System information

Godot v4.6.dev (3edd256a6) - Arch Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Mon, 24 Nov 2025 15:21:09 +0000 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Ti (nvidia; 580.105.08) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-13400F (16 threads) - 15.37 GiB memory

### Issue description

From the Editor Settings dialog opened in the Project Manager, clicking any doc link in the tooltip results in a crash.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6fc41206-7ebf-4483-b59d-dded14cc66a6)

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open the Project Manager
2. Click Settings
3. Click Edit All Settings
4. Hover over any property that has a doc link in its tooltip, e.g., `Editor Language`
5. Click that link and see the engine crashes
